reapack.name: Wwise Relay.lua
reapack.desc: Wwise Relay - update existing Wwise audio after rendering

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi Wwise Relay for Windows x64.\par Requires REAPER 7, ReaWwise, ReaImGui 0.9.3+ and Wwise 2024.1.1.\par Automatically matches WAV filenames to unique existing Sound names. No manual audio links, new objects or WAV backups.\par Test build: verify your NVK render groups before relying on batch coverage.}

version.author: Reaper Tools
version.changelog: Fix launch error caused by GetProjectGUID; use built-in REAPER identity functions. First ReaPack release.

version.author: Reaper Tools
version.changelog: Automatically match rendered WAV filenames to unique existing Wwise Sound names. Remove manual audio links. Skip missing, ambiguous, shared or competing targets. Keep project and platform preferences.

version.author: Reaper Tools
version.changelog: Fix repeating PowerShell windows: reuse one read-only inspector created without a console. Surface failed WAV inspection details and pause instead of silently retrying forever.

version.author: Reaper Tools
version.changelog: Fix the Windows inspector startup hang by launching without inherited handles. Retain quiet persistent inspection and visible WAV errors.
